system.description:
The mage accelerates a living body’s healing, closing wounds, mending bone, and purging toxins. Healing the self requires Life 3; healing another’s complex pattern requires Life 4. Each success repairs a measure of injury, framed coincidentally as a patient’s remarkable recovery.

Dice Pool: Intelligence + Medicine (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Life 3/4; mechanics paraphrased.
